streaming_input.text: First, remove the mug, then put obvious trash and recycling into their bags.
Group pens and cables in one shoebox, use the other for small miscellaneous items
, and make a separate review pile for papers until you decide what to keep.
Keep everyday clothes within easy reach, group seasonal clothes on a sturdy lower shelf,
line up shoes on the floor, and use one shoebox as a review box
for possible donations until you decide.
